RG350M-SYS data partition
=========================

roms/<system>/   ROMs for EmulationStation (nes, snes, gba, psx, megadrive, ...)
bios/            BIOS files for RetroArch (e.g. scph1001.bin for PlayStation,
                 disksys.rom for Famicom Disk System, neogeo.zip for Neo Geo)
local/home/      home directory (EmulationStation + RetroArch settings, saves)

Easier: put a "roms" folder on the SECOND SD card (FAT32 or exFAT), with the
same sub folders. If it exists, EmulationStation uses it instead of this one.
